power.neoorigins.wraith_hunger_drain.des: He ʻauhau ka mālama ʻana i kou kino spectral - hoʻopau ʻoe i ka pōloli 75% ʻoi aku ka wikiwiki ma mua o ka maʻamau.
power.neoorigins.wraith_evolved_night_vi: Ku'u kou mau maka i ka pouli.
power.neoorigins.wraith_evolved_phase.de: E hoʻololi: e hele i waena o nā poloka paʻa me ka lele ʻana i ka wā e holo ana.25% emi iho ka pololi.Hoʻopaʻa mau ʻia ʻo Obsidian a me ka pōhaku lepo iā ʻoe.
power.neoorigins.wraith_ascended_weaknes: ʻO nā ʻenemi kokoke i loko o 3 mau poloka i hoʻopilikia ʻia me ka nāwaliwali.
power.neoorigins.wraith_ascended_dayligh: Ka Nalo ʻana o ka Lā
Ke ʻā mau nei ka lā, akā me ka hapalua o ka ikaika.
power.neoorigins.wraith_apex_phase.name: ʻAno Spectral (Apex)
power.neoorigins.wraith_apex_phase.descr: E hoʻololi: e hele ma waena o nā poloka a pau koe wale ka pōhaku moe me ka lele i ka wā e holo ana.ʻO ka wai pōloli liʻiliʻi.ʻAʻohe mea hiki ke hoʻopaʻa iā ʻoe.
power.neoorigins.wraith_apex_hunger_drai: Ua kūpaʻa kāu ʻano spectral - ʻoi aku ka wikiwiki o ka pōloli ma 25% ma mua o ka maʻamau.
origins.neoorigins.skeleton.name: Kanakaiwi
origins.neoorigins.skeleton.description: He ʻeke iwi hou - wikiwiki, māmā, a make me ke kakaka.ʻO ke kino palupalu, haʻalele ʻia e ka lā, a hiki ke ʻōpū i nā ʻai ʻino loa.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_undead.name: ʻAʻole make
power.neoorigins.skeleton_undead.descrip: ʻAʻole ʻoe i make.ʻO nā lāʻau lapaʻau e hōʻeha iā ʻoe, ʻo nā lāʻau hōʻeha e hoʻōla iā ʻoe, a ʻo nā mea hoʻokalakupua Smite e hōʻeha hou aku iā ʻoe.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_water_breathin: ʻAʻole pono e hanu.Hiki ke ola mau loa ma lalo o ka wai.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_marksmanship.d: +2 pōʻino bonus me nā mea kaua projectile.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_speed.name: Māmā Iwi
power.neoorigins.skeleton_speed.descript: He 20% ka wikiwiki o kou mau wāwae ma kou mau iwi hakahaka.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_jump.name: Māmā
power.neoorigins.skeleton_jump.descripti: E lele 30% kiʻekiʻe ma mua o ka maʻamau.
ʻO kou mau iwi palupalu e hoʻemi i kou olakino kiʻekiʻe i 7 puʻuwai.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_daylight_damag: Puhi ʻoe i ka lā pololei ke ʻole e kau i ka mahiole.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_diet.name: ʻAi iwi ʻole
power.neoorigins.skeleton_diet.descripti: Hiki iā ʻoe ke ʻai wale i ka ʻai iwi, ka ʻiʻo popopo, a me nā maka spider.
Hiki ke ʻai ʻia ka ʻai iwi iā ʻoe.
origins.neoorigins.slime.name: Kelo
origins.neoorigins.slime.description: ʻO kahi mea gelatinous e pono e noho hydrated e ola ai.Paʻa maikaʻi ʻole i ka hāʻule ʻana, haʻalele i ka make ke hoʻomaʻemaʻe maikaʻi ʻia, a ʻoi aku ka paʻakikī me ka ʻike.
power.neoorigins.slime_moisture.name: Māmā
power.neoorigins.slime_moisture.descript: Loaʻa iā ʻoe kahi pahu wai e kahe ana i ka manawa.ʻOi aku ka wikiwiki o ka ʻauʻau ma nā wao nahele a i ke ahi.Kū i loko o ka wai a i ʻole ka ua e hoʻomaʻemaʻe hou.Ma luna o 75%: Regen 1. Ma lalo o 10%: -4 mea kaua.Ma 0%: lawe ʻoe i ka pōʻino.
power.neoorigins.slime_death_save.name: Māhele
power.neoorigins.slime_death_save.descri: Ke make ʻoe me ka ʻoi aku o ka 75% o ka wai, ua māhele ʻoe - ke kelepona ʻana i 50 mau poloka me 2 puʻuwai.Hoʻihoʻi hou kāu max HP i ka maʻamau ma mua o 2 mau minuke.

power.neoorigins.slime_level_hp.descript: +1 max HP no 10 pae ʻike.Hoʻomaka hou i ka make.
